case: SQLite numeric-affinity edits preserve text and exact numbers while refusing overflow, underflow and rounding
contract: SQLite INTEGER, REAL and NUMERIC grid edits retain clearly nonnumeric input as TEXT; MySQL and SQL Server remain strict.
Exactly representable decimals such as 42.50 remain accepted; integer/floating overflow, floating underflow and excess decimal precision are rejected before affinity can lose value.
Native SQLite typeof() confirms grid/import storage classes and untouched sibling rows retain original values.
CHECK-constrained nonnumeric grid writes fail without changing the prior native value.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --lib ui::browse_tab::value_parse::tests::sqlite_numeric_affinity::sqlite_numeric_affinity_grid_edit_preserves_text_and_sibling_values -- --exact --test-threads=1
